description: AI pitch cards over the top-N ranked tickers. Written by .claude/commands/ideas.md via scripts/apply-ideas.mjs. Consumed by /ideas. Each entry is a short investable thesis grounded in the KPI shard + reactions + trend + latest summary — no analyst speculation, no macro narrative, no forward guidance beyond what management already stated.

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the AI run wrote this file.

disclaimer.description: Mandatory user-visible disclaimer. Rendered under the pitch cards on /ideas. Default: 'AI research over the covered universe — not advice, not a recommendation. Cross-check every claim in the primary source before acting.'

rank.description: Rank in the current ranking snapshot (used to link back).

thesis.description: One-line thesis. ≤ 20 words. Plain English. No hype adjectives.

rationale.description: 3-5 sentence rationale grounded in the ticker's ranking components + latest summary. Cites at least one specific KPI or reaction number from the loaded data. NO forward-looking speculation beyond management guidance the summary already captures.

items.description: Concrete risk factor. Cite a real number or a real event (not 'macro uncertainty').

label.description: Upcoming event the pitch pivots on (e.g. 'FY2026 Q3 earnings · Oct 29').

date.description: ISO date when known — usually nextScheduled from the events-index.

ref.description: For 'summary' + 'shard' + 'ranking': the identifier ticker+period or 'ranking.json'. For 'filing' + 'release': a direct URL.
